request: a simple block-building sandbox game with a 32x32 block world
thesis: The pleasure is instant, tactile placing and breaking of chunky blocks until a small world looks like yours.
job: open and see a 32x32 world already there
place blocks by click or drag
see what is selected and where the cursor is
start over with a fresh or empty world

tricks: pre-built terrain so the canvas is never blank
drag-paint with line interpolation between mouse events
tests: can a stranger place a block in under 3 seconds

principles: hover ghost shows what will happen
left place, right break, keys 1-9 pick
tricks: suppress context menu on the canvas
pointer events plus pointer capture so drag works outside canvas
tests: drag across 10 cells fills all with no gaps

principles: blocks read from texture and bevel
tricks: per-block light top edge and dark bottom edge
tiny deterministic noise speckle per cell
tests: each block type distinguishable at a glance

principles: state in one 2D array, render from it

expectations: blocks like dirt, grass, stone, wood, leaves, water, sand, glass

kinds.name: side-view 2D
kinds.what: Terraria-like cross-section, gravity-free placing, sky and ground

descriptions: grass tops dirt, dirt over stone
behaviors: select swatch -> cursor places that type

descriptions: ground line around row 20 to 24 with gentle hills
a tree or two for a hint of what to build
behaviors: reset regenerates starting terrain; clear empties

descriptions: status shows x,y and block under cursor

anti_keywords.not: inventory, crafting, health, mobs, day-night, multiplayer, physics (size word: simple)
anti_keywords.instead: just place, break, palette, undo, save, reset
16 to 24 px chunky cells that fit the viewport

anti_keywords.not: state only in the DOM or a fake click

checks: click places the selected block and the array changes
fits 375 px phone width, touch works
